messages:
alex: Observing a weird oscillation in SSE sessions — many short-lived connections on pool-b this morning. graphs show repeated route flips and sudden quota bumps.

maria: Can you drop the console link? want per-route / per-tenant counters.

alex: https://console/internal/dashboards/sse-pool-b?from=now-1h

jordana: I see the spikes in session_count and route_priority_switches around 12:02 UTC. Any canaries or rollout windows?

sam: I rolled out a tweak to route-fallback priority yesterday (ff=10%) — supposed to be conservative. rolling it back now to be safe.

ops-bot: deploy: route-fallback v1.1 -> v1.0 (rollback) by sam at 1767891240

maria: Proxy logs show a lot of client-initiated closes (499) and resume attempts without resume-token header. sample from proxy: 

```
[proxy] 2026-03-23T12:02:14Z tenant=beta route=pool-b status=499 resume=missing conn=reset
```

alex: Quick repro on client side: our retry loop sometimes fires a new connection while the previous one is still racing to set the resume header. Intermittently we end up with two resume attempts (or missing resume header). local snippet: 

```
# simplified client loop
while !connected:
  open_sse(url, headers)
  # backoff jitter small -> races can happen
```

jordana: Duplicate / missing resume headers cause the proxy to treat attempts as separate sessions; console heuristics label tenant as "high-churn" and drop its route priority. that triggers more failovers. feedback loop.

sam: Action plan: 1) add edge-level dedupe for resume-token (cheap, immediate) 2) tune console priority smoothing to EWMA 5m behind feature flag 3) add telemetry metric sse.resume.duplicates and split dashboard by client_vs_proxy cause.

maria: I'll add the metric and a dashboard card, plus a non-pager alert (warn at 10/min). will gate the EWMA smoothing under ff/sse-priority-ewma.

sam: I'll push the resume dedupe patch to proxy-edge as a 1% canary now.

ops-bot: canary: proxy-edge resume-dedupe -> 1% by sam at 1767891285

jordana: Recommend muting the noisy pager channel during canary so we don't wake folks for expected churn. i'll post a pinned status update.

alex: If you still see 499s after the canary, drop trace ids here and i'll correlate with kv-cache keys & console route swaps.

maria: Added console panels: "sse.resume.duplicates" and "sse.client.closes". alert suppressed for canary window.

sam: Canary looks clean after 15m, no dup traces in logs. promoting to 10%.

ops-bot: rollout: proxy-edge resume-dedupe -> 10% by sam at 1767891400

jordana: Nice work. After we stabilize, let's follow up with a small client-lib change to make resume header emission atomic in the retry path. will assign to devex.

alex: Filed INF-4530 with repro steps, traces, and kv-cache correlations. thanks all :raised_hands:
